data.ruling: The refutation stands. IOBoard.md:360 sets the pack's overcurrent protection "against the cell's continuous-discharge rating and the pack current". In this task the Pack cells function carries the Molicel INR-18650-P30B: the FU-B1 P4 stock return names it as the part under verification for Pack cells. The P2 return had ranked the INR-18650-P26A. The P30B data sheet, Version 1.0, gives "Discharge Current Continuous 30 A (80 degC cut-off)". The list's discharge-overcurrent window "between 12.23 A and 35 A" takes its 35 A upper bound from the P26A's "Discharge Current Maximum 35 A". That figure belongs to a cell that is no longer selected, and it is a maximum, not a continuous rating. Under the list, a threshold between 30 A and 35 A would qualify even though it sits above the selected cell's continuous-discharge rating. The list is therefore weaker than IOBoard.md:360. The corrected window is 12.23 A to 30 A. The short-circuit entry "trips at no more than 35 A" has the same P26A origin and needs the same re-derivation against the P30B. The P30B data sheet states no maximum discharge figure beyond the 30 A continuous rating. The other entries still hold against the P30B: charge voltage 4.2 V, so 4.25 V overvoltage is above it; ambient limits charge 0 to 60 degC and discharge -40 to 60 degC, so the 60 degC cut and the block below 0 degC hold. V149 (location), V137 (2S) and V7 (0 to 50 degC ambient) are also unchanged. The defect is in this function's requirement values, not in the part. The MAX17320 overdischarge comparator (ODTH, 2.5 mV steps up to 77.5 mV) and short-circuit comparator (SCTH, 5 mV steps up to 155 mV) reach 12.5 A to 30 A in 2.5 A steps, and 30 A, with a 1 mOhm sense resistor. The selected MAX17320G22+ still meets the corrected window. Scope: function.
data.evidence: P30B data sheet (Molicel "PRODUCT DATA SHEET ... MODEL INR-18650-P30B", Version 1.0, PDF created 2023-01-31) reads "Discharge Current Continuous 30 A (80oC cut-off)", "Cell Voltage Charge 4.2 V", "Temperature Charge 0°C to 60°C, Discharge -40°C to 60°C", "Charge Current Standard 3A, Maximum 9A (60oC cut-off)", and has no maximum discharge current row. IOBoard.md:360 at e13f5f6: "Pack overcurrent protection | on the 2S pack, set against the cell's continuous-discharge rating and the pack current above; R7 selects it". FU-B1 P2-R7 return: functions/5 requirements "threshold settable between 12.23 A and 35 A" and "trips at no more than 35 A", with found_values/13 sourcing 35 A to the P26A's "Discharge Current Maximum 35 A". FU-B1 P4-stock-R7 return: parts/4 function "Pack cells", part "INR-18650-P30B". MAX17320 Rev 12 (19-100749; Rev 12; 7/25): "Overdischarge nODSCTh, 5-Bit, 2.5mV steps to 77.5mV" and "Short-Circuit nODSCTh, 5-Bit, 5mV steps to 155mV".
